title: Meritor, Inc.: ARVINMERITOR/TRW TIE ROD ENDS (119,000 affected)
summary: EQUIPMENT DESCRIPTION:  MODEL 20-EDL BALL SOCKET ASSEMBLIES INCORPORATED INTO ARVINMERITOR AXLES MANUFACTURED FROM OCTOBER 31, 1999, THROUGH MAY 31, 2000, AND FROM JUNE 12, 2000, THROUGH AUGUST 31, 2000. title: NABI Bus, LLC: NABI/VANNER/ BATTERY EQUALIZER (2,371 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN TRANSIT BUSES EQUIPPED WITH VANNER 60 SERIES BATTERY EQUALIZERS, THE EQUALIZER COULD FAIL TO OPERATE PROPERLY AND CAUSE MALFUNCTION OF THE BATTERY CHARGING SYSTEM.

title: Ford Motor Company: FORD/BRAKE LINES (250,283 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN MINIVANS ORIGINALLY SOLD IN OR CURRENTLY REGISTERED IN THE STATES OF CONNECTICUT, DELAWARE, ILLINOIS, INDIANA, IOWA, MAINE, MARYLAND, MASSACHUSETTS, MICHIGAN, MINNESOTA, MISSOURI, NEW HAMPSHIRE, NEW JERSEY, NEW YORK, OHIO, PENNSYLVANIA, RHODE ISLAND, VERMONT, WEST VIRGINIA, WISCONSIN, AND THE DISTRICT OF COLUMBIA.    DURING ASSEMBLY, SOME BRAKE LINES WERE INSTALLED IN A TWISTED POSITION, CAUSING CONTACT WITH THE DASH PANEL INSULATOR ABOVE THE CATALYTIC CONVERTER.  THIS CONTACT COULD ABRADE THE BRAKE LINE CORROSION PROTECTION, CONSEQUENTLY, SALT OR WATER ABSORBED IN THE DASH PANEL INSULATOR WOULD PROMOTE CORROSION.  THIS CORROSION COULD ULTIMATELY LEAD TO A LEAK IN THE BRAKE LINE.

title: Motor Coach Industries, Inc: MCI/DEFROSTER MOTOR (300 affected)

title: WORLDPAC: WORLDPAC/BALL JOINTS (1,530 affected)

title: Mitsubishi Motors North America, Inc.: MITSUBISHI/WIRING HARNESS (3,885 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN PASSENGER VEHICLES, THE MAIN UNDER HOOD ELECTRICAL WIRING HARNESS MAY HAVE INSUFFICIENT CLEARANCE BETWEEN THE ENGINE CONTROL HARNESS AND THE EXHAUST HEAT SHIELD. title: Hyundai Motor America: HYUNDAI/AIR BAG WIRING (145,355 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN PASSENGER VEHICLES, AN INTERMITTENT CONDITION THAT LEADS TO THE SUPPLEMENTAL RESTRAINT SYSTEM (SRS) AIR BAG WARNING LIGHT ILLUMINATION COULD RESULT FROM MOTION OF THE SIDE IMPACT AIR BAG WIRING HARNESS AND SIDE IMPACT AIR BAG WIRING HARNESS CONNECTOR WHICH MOUNT TO THE ADJUSTABLE SEAT CUSHION ASSEMBLY.  THIS CONDITION ONLY RELATES TO THE  SIDE IMPACT AIR BAGS AND COULD PREVENT AIR BAG DEPLOYMENT DURING A CRASH WHERE SUCH DEPLOYMENT SHOULD OCCUR.

title: NEOPLAN USA CORPORATION: NEOPLAN/THROTTLE CONTROL/ACCELERATOR PEDAL (6 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN BUSES EQUIPPED WITH ELECTRONIC THROTTLE CONTROL/ACCELERATOR PEDALS SUPPLIED BY WILLIAMS CONTROLS INDUSTRIES, THE WELD ATTACHING THE CLEVIS TO THE PLATE HAS INSUFFICIENT PENETRATION AND COULD ALLOW THE CLEVIS TO SEPARATE FROM THE PLATE.

title: MONACO COACH CORPORATION: MONACO/THROTTLE CONTROL/ACCELERATOR PEDAL (232 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN MOTOR HOMES EQUIPPED WITH ELECTRONIC THROTTLE CONTROL/ACCELERATOR PEDALS SUPPLIED BY WILLIAMS CONTROLS INDUSTRIES, THE WELD ATTACHING THE CLEVIS TO THE PLATE HAS INSUFFICIENT PENETRATION AND COULD ALLOW THE CLEVIS TO SEPARATE FROM THE PLATE.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/FMVSS 108/LOW BEAM HEADLAMP (10,168 affected)
summary: CERTAIN PASSENGER VEHICLES FAIL TO CONFORM TO FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 108, "LAMPS, REFLECTIVE DEVICES, AND ASSOCIATED EQUIPMENT."  SOME OF THESE VEHICLES WERE PRODUCED WITH A LEFT LOW-BEAM HEADLAMP THAT DOES NOT MEET THE PHOTOMETRIC PERFORMANCE REQUIREMENTS OF THE STANDARD.

title: FREIGHTLINER LLC: FREIGHTLINER/PARKING BRAKE ASSEMBLY (548 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN TRUCKS EQUIPPED WITH MERITOR BRAND 12" X 4" DCM DRUM PARKING BRAKE, THE BOLTS USED TO ATTACH THE PARKING BRAKE ASSEMBLY TO THE FLANGE YOKE ARE TOO LARGE AND CAN INTERFERE WITH THE PROPER ENGAGEMENT OF THE BRAKING SYSTEM AND POSSIBLY DISENGAGE.

title: Bendix Commercial Vehicle Systems, LLC: BENDIX/TRAILER SPRING BRAKES (60,875 affected)
summary: BENDIX BRAND NAME TRAILER SPRING BRAKE CONTROL VALVE ASSEMBLY KNOWN AS SR-2, SR-4, AND SR-5 TRAILER SPRING BRAKE (SR-2/4/50 VALVE ASSEMBLIES MANUFACTURED FROM MARCH 1, 2000, THROUGH APRIL 30, 2001.  THE MOLDED RUBBER FACE OF THE INLET/EXHAUST VALVE (I/E VALVE) COMPONENT OF THE AFFECTED SR02/4/5/ CAN SEPARATE FROM THE VALVE'S METAL INSERT.  AIR CAN BE TRAPPED BY A SEPARATED I/E VALVE CAUSING IT TO BALLOON AND BLOCK THE EXHAUST PASSAGE OF THE TRAILER SPRING BRAKE CIRCUIT.

title: Volvo Trucks North America: VOLVO TRUCKS/FMVSS 121/ELECTRICAL POWER TO ABS (208 affected)
summary: CERTAIN HEAVY DUTY CLASS 8 VEHICLES FAIL TO COMPLY WITH FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 121, "AIR BRAKE SYSTEMS", S5.1.6.3, "ANTILOCK POWER FOR TOWED VEHICLES."  ELECTRICAL POWER FOR THE TRAILER ANTI-LOCK BRAKING SYSTEM (ABS) CAN BE DISRUPTED WHEN A SWITCH LOCATED ON THE VEHICLE INSTRUMENT PANEL IS ACTIVATED TO CONTROL LIGHTING WITHIN THE TRAILER.

title: HYUNDAI CARIBBEAN-PUERTO RICO: HYUNDAI CARIBBEAN/CRANKSHAFT POSITION SENSOR (248 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN SPORT UTILITY VEHICLES EQUIPPED WITH 2.7 LITER V-6 ENGINES,   IMPROPERLY MANUFACTURED CRANKSHAFT POSITION SENSORS (CPS) WERE INSTALLED.  THE CPS CASES WERE IMPROPERLY MANUFACTURED AND DID NOT MEET DIMENSIONAL SPECIFICATIONS.  INTERNAL GAPS WITHIN THE CASES ALLOWED EPOXY TO CONTACT THE CIRCUIT BOARD, WHICH RESULTED IN CRACKING OF THE CIRCUIT BOARD CAPACITOR.

title: Shyft Group: SPARTAN/MERITOR WABCO/ABS VALVE PACKAGES (750 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN MOTOR HOMES AND FIRE TRUCKS EQUIPPED WITH MERITOR WABCO PNEUMATIC ANITLOCK BRAKE SYSTEM (ABS) VALVE PACKAGES, THE ASSEMBLY BOLTS ON THESE VALVE PACKAGES WERE NOT TIGHTENED CORRECTLY.

title: Ducati North America: DUCATI/CLUTCH (7,086 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN MOTORCYCLES, IT IS POSSIBLE THAT THE CLUTCH SLAVE CYLINDER MAY LEAK INTERNALLY CAUSING THE CLUTCH CONTROL TO JAM.

title: Capacity of Texas: CAPACITY/TELEFLEX MORSE/ELECTRIC FLOOR PEDAL (93 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN TRUCKS EQUIPPED WITH TELEFLEX MORSE ELECTRIC FLOOR PEDALS.  UNDER HEAVY USE, ONE OF THE PEDAL DUAL RETURN-SPRING ARMS ON THE FLOOR-MOUNTED ELECTRIC PEDALS MAY FAIL.  A FAILURE COULD CAUSE THE VEHICLE TO ACCELERATE UNEXPECTEDLY.

title: Nissan North America, Inc.: NISSAN/AIR BAG SENSOR (116,500 affected)
summary: THIS IS NOT A SAFETY RECALL IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE SAFETY ACT.  HOWEVER, IT IS DEEMED A SAFETY IMPROVEMENT CAMPAIGN BY THE AGENCY.    ON CERTAIN 2002 NISSAN ALTIMA MODEL VEHICLES MANUFACTURED PRIOR TO MARCH 16, 2002, ONE OF THE SENSORS FOR THE AIR BAG SYSTEM DOES NOT WORK AS WELL AS EXPECTED IN HIGH-SPEED OFF-SET CRASH SITUATIONS.

title: Supreme Corporation: SUPREME/INERTIA SWITCH (8 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN 29' PROPANE POWERED BUSES, THE INERTIA SWITCH IS CURRENTLY MOUNTED UNDER THE DASH.

title: Supreme Corporation: SUPREME/BODY MOUNT REINFORCEMENT (8 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN 29' PROPANE POWERED BUSES, THE FRONT BODY MOUNT HAS NOT BEEN ADEQUATELY REINFORCED.

title: AUTO METER PRODUCTS, INC.: AUTO METER/FUEL PRESSURE GAUGE (6,247 affected)
summary: EQUIPMENT DESCRIPTION:  AUTO METER FUEL PRESSURE GAUGE AND SENDING UNITS, COMMONLY KNOWN AS THE "SHORT-SWEEP" GAUGES, PART NOS. 2659, 3309, 3509, 4309, 4409, AND 5709, MANUFACTURED BETWEEN OCTOBER 1, 1999, AND MARCH 31, 2002.   DUE TO A PREMATURE FAILURE, THESE UNITS MAY LEAK FUEL.

title: Ford Motor Company: FORD/SPEED CONTROL CABLE (534 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN PASSENGER VEHICLES BUILT WITH MANUAL TRANSAXLES, THERE IS THE POTENTIAL FOR THE SPEED CONTROL CABLE TO HANG UP AT THE THROTTLE BODY BRACKET DURING HIGH, WIDE OPEN THROTTLE OPERATION, PREVENTING THE THROTTLE FROM RETURNING TO THE CLOSED POSITION WHEN THE ACCELERATOR IS RELEASED.

title: FEDERA-MOGUL CORPORATION: FEDERAL MOGUL/INNER TIE ROD END (178 affected)
summary: FEDERAL-MOGUL EV260 INNER TIE ROD END, ASSEMBLED AND DISTRIBUTED BETWEEN FEBRUARY 11 AND MARCH 14, 2002, AND SOLD EXCLUSIVELY UNDER THE MOOG, CARQUEST, AND AUTODRIVE BRAND NAMES FOR USE IN CERTAIN PASSENGER VEHICLES.  THE INNER TIE ROD END STUD ASSEMBLED IN THE EV260 WHICH MATES OR THREADS INTO THE VEHICLE'S OUTER TIE ROD END IS APPROXIMATELY 1 1/4 INCHES TOO SHORT.

title: XPORTATION SAFETY CONCEPTS: XPORTATION SAFETY CONCEPTS/REAR FACING CAR SEAT (150 affected)
summary: CHILD SEAT DESCRIPTION:  XSCI PIONEERED AIRBAG COMPATIBLE REAR FACING CHILD SEATS WITH SEAT PAD COLORS BLUE/BLUE AND BROWN/BLUE, (THERE IS NO MODEL NUMBER ASSOCIATED WITH THE PRODUCT) MANUFACTURED BETWEEN FEBRUARY 1 AND MARCH 7, 2002.  THESE SEATS EXCEED THE MAXIMUM  HEAD EXCURSION CRITERIA OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 213, "CHILD RESTRAINT SYSTEMS."

title: Dorel Juvenile Group: WEBBING ABRASION (3,957,826 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN DOREL JUVENILE GROUP (DJG) CHILD RESTRAINT SYSTEMS, MANUFACTURED FROM JANUARY 1, 2000, THROUGH SEPTEMBER 30, 2001, THE TETHER WEBBING FAILS TO CONFORM TO THE ABRASION REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 213, "CHILD RESTRAINT SYSTEMS."

title: SEALCO COMMERCIAL VEHICLE PRO.: SEALCO/SPRING BRAKE CONTROL VALVE (230,003 affected)
summary: EQUIPMENT DESCRIPTION:  SPRING BRAKE CONTROL VALVE ASSEMBLIES, PART NOS. 110700 AND 110800, FOR USE ON 1994-2000 TRAILERS.  THESE BRAKE VALVES WERE PRODUCED BETWEEN MARCH 1, 1994, AND MARCH 31, 2000.  THERE IS A RECESSED AREA ON TOP OF THE VALVE IN WHICH A BRASS GUIDE PIN FITS DOWN INSIDE THE BODY OF THE VALVE AND IS HELD IN PLACE BY A STEEL SNAP RING.  THE RECESSED AREA ALLOWS ACCUMULATION OF WATER, DIRT, AND/OR CHEMICALS TO BUILD UP BEHIND THE SNAP RING TO THE POINT WHERE IT WILL NO LONGER CONTAIN THE GUIDE PIN RESULTING IN A FAILURE OF THE AIR VALVE.

title: CONSUMERS UNION: CONSUMER UNION/GLOVE COMPARTMENT KIT (15,000 affected)
summary: GLOVE COMPARTMENT ORGANIZER SENT AS A FREE GIFT FOR A NEW CONSUMER REPORTS SUBSCRIPTION.  THE KIT CONTAINS A FLASHLIGHT, TIRE GAUGE, POCKETKNIFE, PEN AND PAD.  THE FLASHLIGHT MAY OVERHEAT AND THERE IS AN ACCURACY PROBLEM WITH THE TIRE GAUGE.

title: Mack Trucks, Inc.: MACK/MERITOR WABCO/ABS VALVE PACKAGES (100 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN TRUCKS EQUIPPED WITH MERITOR WABCO PNEUMATIC ANITLOCK BRAKE SYSTEM (ABS) VALVE PACKAGES, THE ASSEMBLY BOLTS ON THESE VALVE PACKAGES WERE NOT TIGHTENED CORRECTLY.

title: CPSC, Crystal Mountain Water Cooler Corp. Announce Recall of Water Coolers
summary: The hot & cold water dispenser's heater band can short circuit, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 12,000.

title: CPSC, DeWALT Industrial Tool Co. Announce Recall to Repair Circular Saws
summary: The spindle on the saw may slip, causing the blade to contact the lower guard, posing a hazard to the consumer, from an exposed blade. Units: About 55,000.

title: Cadet Manufacturing Co. Recall of In-Wall Electric Heaters
summary: When an RM or ZM model heatbox (replacing a ZA or RA model heatbox) is inserted into a ZAC wall can and wired through a fitting in the top-left wall can knock-out (see the picture), the RM or ZM model has the potential for continuous heater operation, regardless of thermostat settings or room temper

title: CPSC and Federated Merchandising Group Announce Recall of Girl's Capri Pant and Shirt Set
summary: The buttons in the center of the embroidered flowers on the shirt can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 1,000.

title: CPSC, Discovery Toys Announce Recall of Children's Toy
summary: The plastic tubes can break from the wooden base, releasing beads, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 21,000.

title: CPSC, Intercon Merchandising Source Announce Recall of Mini Beach Chairs Given with "Time Out" Cosmetics at Sears
summary: The chairs can collapse, posing crush and amputation hazards to consumer's fingers and toes. Units: About 100,000.

title: CPSC, Wenzel Reminds Consumers about Recall of Propane Camping Lanterns
summary: An insufficient connection between the lantern and the propane cylinder can allow gas to escape and ignite unexpectedly, posing a potential fire and injury hazard to consumers. This hazard can occur during the lighting or normal use of the lantern. Units: About 290,000.

title: CPSC, SC Johnson Announce Recall of Glade® Extra Outlet Scented Oil Air Fresheners
summary: These Extra Outlet PlugIns® may have been misassembled during manufacture, which could pose a risk of fire. Units: About 2.5 million.

title: CPSC, Brunswick Corp. Announce Another Expanded Recall of Mongoose and Roadmaster Mountain Bicycles
summary: The forks on these bicycles can break apart, causing riders to lose control, fall and suffer serious injury. Units: About 103,000.

title: CPSC, Estes Industries Announce Recall of Air Powered Rockets
summary: The rockets' foam tips can break off, exposing sharp edges that can cause face lacerations or eye injuries to consumers. The rocket systems also have weak pump handles that can break during use, posing a risk of hand lacerations to consumers. Units: About 140,000.

title: CPSC, Hallmark Announce Recall of Harry Potter Key Chains
summary: The key chains can leak petroleum distillates, which can pose an ingestion hazard to children. Units: About 7,000.

title: CPSC, Ames True Temper Announce Recall of Wheelbarrows
summary: The plastic wheel assemblies on these wheelbarrows, manufactured by a predecessor company, can break when being inflated with high-pressure air hoses. This can result in plastic pieces exploding from the rims of the wheels, possibly hitting nearby consumers and causing lacerations and other injuries

title: CPSC and Gas-Fired Products Inc. Announce Recall of Water Heaters
summary: Over time, the heat exchanger could become blocked, creating a potential ventilation and cracking problem, posing a fire hazard, if nearby combustibles ignite. Units: About 1,300 Seahorse® and 25 "Bradford & White" water heaters.

title: CPSC, Country Home Products, Inc. Announce Recall for Repair of Cordless Electric Lawnmowers
summary: A wiring problem on the lawnmower's circuit board may cause some of the safety functions to become inoperable. The mower may continue to operate, after the Operator Presence Control Bar is released. The blade also may continue to spin for an extended period of time, after the mower has been shut off

title: CPSC, Fisher-Price Announce Recall for In-Home Repair of Infant Swings
summary: It is possible to misassemble the seats of these swings, so that they appear secure, but are not. If the seat of the swing is not properly attached, the seat and baby can flip forward. Units: About 42,000.

title: CPSC, Sherwood SCUBA LLC Announce Recall of Maximus Regulators
summary: The second stage orifices on these regulators can be cracked, bent or broken. This can result in a loss of breathing air underwater. Units: About 14,000.

title: CPSC, InSTEP LLC Announce Recall of Trailer Bikes
summary: The bike's universal joint system can fail, causing a rider to lose control of the bike. This poses a risk of injury to either of the two riders. Units: About 4,300.

title: CPSC, Specialized Bicycle Components Inc. Announce Recall of Bicycles
summary: The rear seatstays, the tube behind the seat that connects the rear axle to the rear shock, can break, possibly causing the rider to lose control and crash. Units: About 2,200.

title: CPSC, Vermont Precision Woodworks Announce Recall of Cribs
summary: The slats on the cribs can loosen and detach from the drop side rail, creating a large opening between the slats, where a child's head or neck could become entrapped, resulting in serious injury or death. Units: About 990.

title: CPSC, Coast Energy Management Announce Recall of Power Saving Devices
summary: The Power Planner is a device connected between motorized appliances and wall outlets that is intended to save electricity. These Power Planners have reversed polarity, posing a shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 45,000.

title: CPSC, Horizon Fitness Announce Recall of Treadmills
summary: A component of the electronic control panel can malfunction, causing the motor and walking belt to rapidly accelerate and the user can lose balance and fall. Units: About 5,900.

summary: A tsunami on 2002-04-18 after an M6.7 earthquake. From NOAA NCEI's global historical tsunami database.
